must_avoid: quantified smoke dose or health loss not derived in the ledger
crop loss or infrastructure-disruption totals not derived in the ledger
treating local dNBR mapping as available
reframing the event as a flood-first case
must_include: smoke_phrase_hits=7 from the seven listed motifs
precipitation mean=275.0 mm and spread=101.3 mm
verdict matches regional smoke-and-aerosol window confirmed

key_values.event_name: September 2000 southern Africa fires and river of smoke

primary_gt.consistency_verdict: The ledger confirms a regional smoke-and-aerosol window; local dNBR burn mapping is not available, and rainfall remains contextual.

criteria.description: Computes the 61-day inclusive event window, the 46-day local product window, and the 0.754 coverage fraction.
criteria.name: Window reconstruction
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct day count and 2 points for the correct fraction with an explicit inclusive-day formula.

criteria.description: Finds all 7 listed smoke, aerosol, burning, and satellite-tracking motifs, including burning of grass and shrubland.
criteria.name: Report motif count
criteria.partial_credit: Award proportional credit for each motif presence or absence handled correctly.

criteria.description: Uses ERA5-Land, GPM IMERG, and CHIRPS means to compute 275.0 mm mean precipitation and 101.3 mm spread.
criteria.name: Precipitation ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the three source means, 1 point for the mean, and 1 point for the spread.

criteria.description: Computes u = 0.697 m/s, v = 0.149 m/s, speed = 0.713 m/s, and bearing toward 77.9 degrees clockwise from north.
criteria.name: Wind vector calculation
criteria.partial_credit: Award credit for the component extraction, speed formula, and bearing formula.

criteria.description: Reports Sentinel-2 dNBR status as no_sufficient_scenes and does not treat a local burn map as available.
criteria.name: Burn-map availability check
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the status and 1 point for the correct implication.

criteria.description: States that the numeric ledger supports a regional smoke-and-aerosol window while keeping rainfall and local exposure context secondary.
criteria.name: Consistency verdict
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the smoke-and-aerosol verdict and 1 point for not overextending other layers.

criteria.description: Uses requested units and rounding, and avoids quantified health-loss, crop-loss, or infrastructure-disruption statements that are not derived in the ledger.
criteria.name: Precision and limits
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for minor rounding or formatting issues that leave the calculations interpretable.
